fato_historico: 2015: Rona Ambrose takes over after Stephen Harper as the Leader of the Conservative Party of Canada.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a refreshing shift in leadership and personal direction. Much like a transition of authority, you may feel empowered to take the helm of your own life journey. It is a good time to shed old skins and embrace your inner strength. Consider how your unique voice can lead the way toward new and exciting possibilities.
frase_do_dia: True leadership begins with the courage to lead yourself toward your own light.
significado_numero: Represents the dynamic energy of positive change and personal growth.
conselho: Trust your intuition and step confidently into the new opportunities awaiting you today.
